placements.why: Both segments are organizational acts — bare imperatives commanding suppression of knowledge and erasure of a prior decision. No existing strata category covers organizational governance; this mint provides the home for such content.
placements.title: Organizational acts and governance
placements.frame: What organizational decisions, directives, and acts shape how the institution operates and what it retains?

placements.title: From retention to directed erasure of institutional knowledge
placements.frame: When does authority direct the suppression or removal of knowledge and prior decisions, and what does the erasure target?
placements.why: Both segments perform the same thematic act: a bare imperative commanding erasure — one targeting a specific prior decision ('Forget the Quantum Widget Decision'), the other targeting the totality of knowledge about a named migration ('Remove all knowledge about the PostgreSQL to QuantumDB migration'). No existing leaf holds this theme. The grain test passes: directed knowledge suppression is a subject future envelopes will keep feeding, not a one-time fact.
